title: Majora's Moon
description: A Texturepack For changing the Minecraft moon to the Majora's Mask moon giving us nightmares every time we sleep
body:
## 🌕Majora's Moon🌕

This is a simple resourcepack changing the cubic moon to the Majora's mask moon
I could add some other things later and hope to do so.
